\caption{Feasibility classifier safety metrics. False-safe = configurations admitted (predicted safe) that actually violate the SLO. The classifier is calibrated to minimize false-safe admissions first; the high false-safe rates (FS\%) at loose SLOs reflect very few violating configurations in that regime (small denominators), not many unsafe admissions.
